verdict: Service in the focus hours is significantly worse than the baseline on late_share.

evidence: [R] 83% of late trains were already late at Prospect Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 59 St: 3, at 45 St: 1, at 36 St: 1, on approach from Prospect Av: 1.

[N] 100% of mildly late (>= 120s) trains were already late at Prospect Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 59 St: 4, at or before Prospect Av: 1, at 36 St: 1. Largest time loss on segment 45 St -> 36 St (median +115s vs schedule).
[N] 100% of headway gaps at the target already existed at Prospect Av.

[D] 88% of mildly late (>= 120s) trains were already late at Prospect Av (inherited delay). Origins: at 36 St: 4, on approach from Prospect Av: 1, at Fort Hamilton Pkwy: 1, at Prospect Av: 1. Largest time loss on segment 9 Av -> 36 St (median +175s vs schedule).
80% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 73%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.
[N] Time is lost a little at every stop (53 St -> 45 St +35s, 45 St -> 36 St +115s, 25 St -> Prospect Av +85s): a dwell-time / crowding pattern rather than one bad segment.
Weekend problem rate is 2.6x the weekday rate; weekend service changes / planned work likely.
6% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 3.7x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 29% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (1.0x the system share) in the analysed months.
Adverse-weather days have 1.9x the problem rate (4 adverse days).
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 436s on average vs 145s otherwise (3.0x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 33% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (1.0x the system share) in the analysed months.
10% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'police' alert was active for the line (problem rate 32% with an alert vs 27% without, lift 1.1x).
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 20% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (0.9x the system share) in the analysed months.
6% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'unknown' alert was active for the line (problem rate 32% with an alert vs 27% without, lift 1.1x).
3% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'rolling_stock' alert was active for the line (problem rate 32% with an alert vs 27% without, lift 1.1x).

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on R, N, D, W during 22:00-23:00: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Dwell-time programme at 4 Av-9 St and the stops before it during 22:00-23:00: platform controllers, door-closing announcements, step-back crews
recommendations.rationale: Run-time loss is spread across every stop on the approach, the signature of long dwells.
recommendations.expected_effect: Each stop recovers its excess dwell; the effect compounds along the line.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for R, N, D, W; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Check whether scheduled dwell and run times on the approach still match observed loads; re-time the schedule if not
recommendations.rationale: A schedule with unrealistic dwells makes every train late by design.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for R, N, D, W; add supplement trains or move work windows off 22:00-23:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Activate the adverse-weather plan (drainage checks, heat-related speed restrictions review, snow plan) on forecast adverse days
recommendations.rationale: Problem rate rises on adverse-weather days.

recommendations.action: Set a gap-filling rule: dispatch the next available train from Coney Island-Stillwell Av when a gap over 19 min forms
recommendations.rationale: A fifth of arrivals follow a large gap.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the longest waits, which dominate the APT metric.

recommendations.action: On rainy/snowy days budget extra time for R, N, D, W at 4 Av-9 St
recommendations.rationale: Weather sensitivity is measurable at this station.

sources_used: NY Open Data: trains delayed / incidents
caveats: scheduled counts scaled by observed coverage (1412 polling intervals); hours covered < 50% excluded from service delivered
